summary: Zellij 0.45.1 web build on 127.0.0.1 only, isolated dirs. Unauthenticated API and websocket requests got 401. A read-only token watched a shared session (terminal output received) but typed input did not reach the pane; a read-write token's input did (positive control). A read-only login could not create a session. Revoking a token invalidated its existing browser session at once. The session cookie is HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, without Secure over HTTP; remember-me adds Max-Age 2419200 (28 days). The terminal websocket accepted a foreign Origin header from a non-browser client holding a valid cookie. Sessions are refused unless web sharing is on, and a session run by the no-web build was never offered and refused web connections. The installed no-web 0.45.1 cannot run the web server at all.

no_web_build.note: the pinned no-web build (zellij_pins.json) answered every web verb with 'This version of Zellij was compiled without web server support'

isolation.dirs: private HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, TMPDIR, ZELLIJ_CONFIG_DIR and a short private ZELLIJ_SOCKET_DIR (the scratch path exceeded the 107-byte socket limit)
isolation.bind: 127.0.0.1 on a free ephemeral port; no other address was used
isolation.sessions: uniquely named probe sessions only (one shared, one created with web sharing off by config, one created with the CLI option, one run by the no-web build); one extra session that a stray 'zellij options' call started in the isolated socket dir was killed as well; every session was killed and the web server stopped at the end; no maintainer session was listed, attached or touched
isolation.secrets: tokens and cookies were read by the probe and never written to this file

security_headers_on_root.content-security-policy: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' ws: wss:; img-src 'self' data:

read_only_create_new_session.note: the bootstrap answered 200 with is_read_only true, but list-sessions showed no new session

ws_control_invalid_client_id_with_origin.note: 403 for a made-up web_client_id regardless of Origin; it does not test an Origin check

web_sharing_off_session.control_message: This session does not allow web connections.

session_created_with_cli_option_web_shar.note: attach --create-background NAME options --web-sharing off did not stop watching; the config value applied. Not investigated further

session_run_by_no_web_build.control_message: This session does not allow web connections.

token_store.format: SQLite; tokens table holds token_hash, name, created_at, read_only; session_tokens holds hashed session tokens with expiry

cli_quirks: --token-name was refused together with --create-token and with --create-read-only-token ('cannot be used with one or more of the other specified arguments')
after revoking token_1 of two tokens, the next --create-token failed: "Token name 'token_2' already exists"; revoke-all then worked

not_tested: binding to any address other than 127.0.0.1
a real browser (cookie and Origin behaviour of browsers)
whether the web server counts as a unix-socket peer that makes zellij focus refuse parent activation
the share plugin toggling sharing at runtime
